'''Sakuub''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Sakuub system/Legends|Sakuub system]] of [[Pelgrin sector/Legends|Pelgrin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the homeworld of the [[Sakuubian]]s.

The planet contained [[Old Town (Sakuub)|Old Town]] and the [[Sky Temple of Karsol]], and was a tourist spot for its [[Sector/Legends|sector]].

In [[44 ABY]], after the defeat of [[Abeloth]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Jagged Fel]] honeymooned there.
